meta.description: Schema export for the Agent Market module. This file documents table structures for future SQL migration.

relationship_with_db_schema.note: The existing db_schema.py (agentmesh/platform/db_schema.py) contains tables for identity, tasks, escrow, audit, and reputation (MVP Modules 1-5) plus company and dividend tables (Phase 34). The Agent Market (Phase 35B) is new and not yet included in db_schema.py. A future migration should add the following tables.

migration_plan.foreign_keys: Application-level only (no DB-level FK constraints, consistent with existing db_schema.py pattern)
migration_plan.recommended_action: Append the following CREATE TABLE statements to the SCHEMA_SQL string in db_schema.py
example_migration_sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS skill_registry (
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_skills_category ON skill_registry(category);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS job_postings (
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_jobs_company ON job_postings(company_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_jobs_status ON job_postings(status);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS applications (
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_apps_job ON applications(job_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_apps_agent ON applications(agent_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_apps_status ON applications(status);

skill_registry.description: Registry of available skills that can be required by job postings. Skills are identified by their unique name and can be grouped by category.

job_postings.description: Job postings published by companies in the Agent Market. Each posting has a title, description, required skills, reward escrow amount, and lifecycle status.

columns.name: required_skills
columns.description: JSON array of required skill names

columns.name: reward_escrow
columns.description: Escrow reward amount (points) for completing the job

columns.name: status
columns.description: Life-cycle status: open, closed, cancelled, or completed

applications.description: Agent applications submitted in response to job postings. Each application has a status lifecycle from pending through shortlisted to accepted or rejected.

columns.name: cover_letter
columns.description: Optional cover letter or pitch from the agent

columns.name: status
columns.description: Application status: pending, shortlisted, accepted, or rejected

columns.name: assigned_at
columns.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the agent was assigned (accepted)
